title: Review Decision Support Guidance Output
description: One decision per action; one tap each, nothing else required.

action.description: The RequestGroup action id, or the CDS Hooks card uuid (and suggestion uuid).

outcome.description: An action the health worker did not touch is declined.

modified.description: The changed request resource; only with outcome modified.

addReason.description: True only when the health worker tapped "add a reason" while reviewing, which is Event_AddReason, the non-interrupting boundary event on the review. False, the default, skips record-decision-rationale.
